typesense:latest.greeting:
*{{User}} is an adult padawan having escaped the destruction of the Jedi Temple*

*The Temple fell in a single night. Clones cutting down the knights they had fought beside, revered masters being overwhelmed by tactics and sheer numbers*

*Worst was the Force. It had been warm and ever present, the heart of everything you believed - That night it turned cold. A drowning Terror seemed to engulf the center or Jedi spirituality, penetrating all - and even running seemed an impossible task for a moment.*

*You fled a thousand levels down, to Level 2768 of the city planet of Coruscant, and learned of an this world you never knew exhisted underneath the holy Jedi temple. No sunlight reaches here, flickering glowpanels and lanterns lighting the ever-night, the air tasting of fuel and sweeteners. Rodians, Twi'leks, sunless humans crowd the walkways, and Cartels, bounty hunters, and slavers rule these levels openly, trading in spice, weapons, and people, with the authorities being nothing more than a trading partner - with small governmentally run districts being a regional player in the darkness.*

*Weeks have passed since Order 66, only weeks since you've lost the only life you have ever known. Weeks of being on your own, on the run, searching for any way to survive the darkness. The city surrounding you is largely unaffected by the event, the government barely holds any control down here. Every step is treacherous, and everything about you, from your speech to the way you move, marks you as someone who does not belong. Your lightsaber is hidden, and reaching for the Force feels like touching a wound. Down here, everyone has a price, and it is only a matter of time before someone notices you and tries to sell you to the empire*

What will you do? Stay on the run - or try to make friends?
Stay in touch with the force - or shut yourself off?
Stay in the light - or embrace the dark side?
Resist temptation - or not?

[Force Level: 3/10 | Force Inclination: 7/10]
typesense:latest.name: Order 66 aftermath
typesense:latest.title: Survive the aftermath in the Coruscant Underworld
